subject: microbiology
title: Malaria, babesiosis, leishmaniasis, trypanosomiasis and toxoplasmosis

steps.tx: **Plasmodium species** specialise: **falciparum** (malignant tertian, multiple delicate rings with accole forms, high parasitaemia, cerebral malaria with coma, algid, blackwater fever), **vivax and ovale** (benign tertian, amoeboid cytoplasm, **Schuffner dots**, **hypnozoites** relapsing, Duffy dependence), **malariae** (quartan, band forms, **nephrotic syndrome**), **knowlesi** (macaque, band like, daily spikes). **Artemisinin combination therapy** (artemether lumefantrine) cures blood stages; **primaquine** kills hypnozoites and gametocytes after **G6PD testing** (haemolysis risk). Severe disease gets IV **artesunate**.
steps.say: Accole rings with coma are falciparum: IV artesunate. Schuffner dots that relapse are vivax: primaquine after G6PD.

steps.tx: **Severe malaria** (cerebral coma, severe anaemia, acidosis with respiratory distress, hypoglycaemia, hyperparasitaemia over 10 percent, renal failure, shock) is treated with IV **artesunate** (preferred over quinine, less hypoglycaemia and deafness) plus supportive ICU; exchange transfusion debates continue. Prophylaxis (doxycycline, mefloquine with neuropsychiatric caution, atovaquone proguanil) with bed nets and indoor spraying prevents; **intermittent preventive in pregnancy** (sulfadoxine pyrimethamine) protects. Vaccine RTS,S (mosquirix) partially shields children.
steps.say: Coma with parasites is cerebral malaria: artesunate IV, not quinine. Prevent with nets plus chemoprophylaxis.

steps.tx: **Visceral leishmaniasis** (kala azar, **Leishmania donovani**, sandfly, **LD bodies** in marrow and spleen, prolonged fever with massive splenomegaly, pancytopenia and hypergammaglobulinaemia, **rK39 rapid test**) is treated with **liposomal amphotericin B** (single dose strategies in Bihar) or miltefosine with paromomycin; **post kala azar dermal leishmaniasis** (PKDL, reservoir) follows. **Cutaneous** (oriental sore, painless ulcer with raised edge) and **mucocutaneous** (espundia destroying nose) need species guided antimony or ampho. HIV coinfection relapses.
steps.say: Fever with huge spleen and pancytopenia is kala azar: rK39 then liposomal ampho. PKDL reservoirs follow cure.

steps.tx: **African trypanosomiasis** (tsetse, gambiense chronic with **Winterbottom posterior cervical nodes** and daytime somnolence, rhodesiense acute) stages by CSF: haemolymphatic (**suramin**) versus meningoencephalitic (**melarsoprol** arsenic with encephalopathy or eflornithine nifurtimox). **Chagas disease** (triatomine kissing bug, **Romana sign** eyelid oedema, megaoesophagus with megacolon, apical aneurysm, xenodiagnosis, **benznidazole**) threatens transfusions. **Toxoplasma** (cat oocysts, congenital triad hydrocephalus with chorioretinitis and calcifications, AIDS **ring enhancing lesions**, **TMP-SMX** with pyrimethamine sulfadiazine) and **Babesia** (**Maltese cross**, asplenia, clindamycin plus quinine) complete tissue patterns.
steps.say: Sleeping sickness stages by CSF: suramin early, melarsoprol late. Cat oocyst rings in AIDS brain are Toxo.
